stem.text: Let \( f(x) = \begin{cases} \frac{x^{2} - 9}{x - 3}, & x < 3 \\ kx + m, & 3 \le x \le 4 \\ - 2 x^{2} - 8, & x > 4 \end{cases} \), where k and m are constants. Find the values of k and m for which f is continuous for all real numbers.

answer_key.label: \( k = -46 \) and \( m = 144 \), because the middle branch must equal 6 at \( x = 3 \) and -40 at \( x = 4 \).

worked_solution.text: For \( x < 3 \), \( \frac{x^{2} - 9}{x - 3} = x + 3 \), so the limit from the left at \( x = 3 \) is 6. The middle branch gives \( f(3) = 3k + m \), so \( 3k + m = 6 \).
worked_solution.rule_named: match the branches at the first boundary

worked_solution.text: At \( x = 4 \) the middle branch gives \( f(4) = 4k + m \) and the last branch approaches -40, so \( 4k + m = -40 \).
worked_solution.rule_named: match the branches at the second boundary

worked_solution.text: Subtracting the equations gives \( k = -46 \), and then \( m = 144 \).

options.derivation: at x = 3 the last branch, which applies only for x > 4, used in place of the first branch
